'''Bes''' was a world located in the [[Bes system/Legends|Bes system]],<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" /> within the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A space battle between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place near Bes during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />
